environment.description: Same application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has two listener rules: (1) a fixed-response rule at priority 5 matching path /api/users/search with query string parameter 'q' containing any value with a single-quote character (returns 403), and (2) an AWS WAF WebACL association with a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' containing a RegexPatternSet match on query string values against pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*(?:or|and)\s+['"]?\d)` with BLOCK action at priority 100, plus the AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 200 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule overridden to COUNT. The WAF WebACL default action is ALLOW. Additionally, the ECS task role has no S3 or Secrets Manager permissions, and the task definition sets readonlyRootFilesystem: true with a tmpfs mount only at /tmp.
